description: Broad questions a closed-book model can reasonably attempt, each still bound to a gold calendar chunk — used by eval/run_ablation.py as the 'general' arm. gold_ids are valid only for the 3,770-chunk index built 2026-08-31; regenerate after any re-ingest.

items.question: What happens to a UBC student's academic standing, and what standings exist?
items.reference_answer: There are three levels of academic standing: In Good Standing, On Academic Probation, and Failed, Required to Withdraw. Students enter the University In Good Standing.

items.question: Roughly how many credits does a UBC B.Sc. degree require?
items.reference_answer: A minimum of 120 credits; some options require more.

items.question: What is CPSC 110 at UBC about?
items.reference_answer: CPSC 110, Computation, Programs, and Programming (4 credits), covers fundamental program and computation structures.

items.question: What kinds of requirements does a UBC Bachelor of Arts student have to complete?
items.reference_answer: B.A. students complete a set of faculty-wide degree requirements — for current entrants (2024/25 or later): Writing and Research, Ways of Knowing Breadth, Outside, Upper-level, and Arts Credit Minimum; earlier cohorts also had separate Language, Science, and Literature requirements.
